mapper.sql: market_id, symbol, window_start, window_end, status, attempts, next_attempt_at, deadline_at, result_option_id, last_reason, last_attempt_at, version, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO resolve_auto_task (market_id, symbol, window_start, window_end, status, attempts, next_attempt_at, deadline_at, last_reason, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{marketId}, #{symbol}, #{windowStart}, #{windowEnd}, #{status}, 0, #{nextAttemptAt}, #{deadlineAt}, #{lastReason}, 0, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT market_id FROM resolve_auto_task WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RESOLVING') AND next_attempt_at <= #{now} ORDER BY next_attempt_at, market_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE resolve_auto_task SET status = 'RESOLVED', last_reason = #{reason}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE market_id = #{marketId} AND status = 'RESOLVING'
UPDATE resolve_auto_task SET next_attempt_at = #{next}, last_reason = #{reason}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE market_id = #{marketId} AND status = 'RESOLVING'
UPDATE resolve_auto_task SET status = 'CLOSED', last_reason = #{reason}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE market_id = #{marketId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RESOLVING')
mapper.select: SELECT FROM resolve_auto_task WHERE status = 'MANUAL' ORDER BY updated_at DESC, market_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resolve_auto_task WHERE status = 'MANUAL'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resolve_record (market_id, kind, option_id, detail, note, actor, created_at) VALUES (#{marketId}, #{kind}, #{optionId}, #{detail}, #{note}, #{actor}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, market_id, kind, option_id, detail, note, actor, created_at FROM resolve_record WHERE market_id = #{marketId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, market_id, kind, option_id, detail, note, actor, created_at FROM resolve_record WHERE market_id = #{marketId} AND kind = #{kind} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: id, market_id, source, attempt, request_url, http_status, body, body_sha256, outcome, parsed, error, fetched_at, elapsed_ms
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resolve_source_fetch (market_id, source, attempt, request_url, http_status, body, body_sha256, outcome, parsed, error, fetched_at, elapsed_ms) VALUES (#{marketId}, #{source}, #{attempt}, #{requestUrl}, #{httpStatus}, #{body}, #{bodySha256}, #{outcome}, #{parsed}, #{error}, #{fetchedAt}, #{elapsedMs})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM resolve_source_fetch WHERE market_id = #{marketId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM resolve_source_fetch WHERE id IN #{i}
